newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU to change sugar storage rules on Wednesday.
newsitem.headline: EU to change sugar storage rules on Wednesday.

text.p: The European Union is expected to agree a technical change to its sugar minimum storage rules next Wednesday, a member state official said.

The official was speaking after the EU's sugar management committee on Wednesday discussed changing a regulation to replace the threshold price with a flat rate amount to fix the penalty for failing to store the minimum amount of sugar.
The change is needed to conform with the GATT Uruguay Round agreement.
EU sugar manufacturers are required to keep part of their "A" production quota in store for use in times of emergency. -Brussels Bureau +322 287 6830
